text: This tiny egg, in a cold river, holds a big adventure.
It hatches, and grows into a little fry.
As a smolt, it swims all the way down to the sea.
In the ocean, it eats and eats, and grows into a big, strong adult.
But one day, it turns around, and swims back home.
It jumps up waterfalls, all the way to the place where it was born.
There, it lays its eggs. That's called spawning. And the circle starts again.
